planting.note: Set divisions out in spring once nights stay reliably above 50°F, planting in humus-rich, shaded soil with the crown just at grade.

directions: This sport of the species palm lily carries bold creamy-white longitudinal stripes down each pleated, lance-shaped leaf, giving it a brighter, more ornamental presence in deep shade than the plain green form. It stays noticeably more compact and a touch slower to bulk up than the species, so give it dappled or filtered light rather than the densest shade to keep the variegation crisp and prevent leaf scorch in direct sun. Because seedlings revert to solid green, propagate only by dividing the clumping rhizomes in spring, discarding any all-green shoots that appear. Protect the crown with mulch where winter lows approach freezing, since foliage is damaged below the high 20s even though the roots survive into zone 8b.
